language_semantics.frontier_delta: Keep every ordinary change on a machine-consumed parent seam. Parallel decoding, catalog-score factorization, tokenizer, codebook, SID, alignment, staging, resolution, dense-retrieval, or generator changes are honest CUSTOM_MODEL comparisons, not disconnected parent-local helpers.
language_semantics.single_root_search_tree: LIGER is the frozen root comparator; after a faithful measured improvement, that descendant may become the active construction parent while the root comparison stays fixed.
language_semantics.success: A faithful legal-item candidate improves LIGER on the same Beauty data/dev NDCG@10 protocol with all stage costs charged.
